g.text: Larger nested regions omit fewer reference pixels

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546575

g.text: Synthetic toy · one image represented by five valid positions and one padding position · five expert masks

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #546575

g.text: Each row repeats the same prediction for one expert. Dots mark reference pixels: orange = omitted; white = included.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #546575

g.text: Expert omissions are averaged equally, after upward quantization for calibration. This toy illustrates the rule; it is not retinal evidence.
